methods.contract_guarantee: prepare_issue atomically records the original D intent and its one-time local forwarding claim. Only the first definitely committed claim may receive an issuer-held OpaqueIssuePermit, bound to C/D/binding/epoch and consumed by the guarded driver boundary. Same-key replay, transaction lookup, lost/uncertain commit or process restart never mints a fresh permit for D. A returned historical token has runtime_permit=None. Field copies/JSON cannot forge the permit. Crash after claim and before actual send conservatively retains possible effects until scoped reconciliation. This controls coordinator forwarding, not provider duplicate execution or native exactly-once.
